description: §19.16.1 (S430 round 6) — `defer [ … ]…` with whitespace before `[` is a defer statement (the array-literal statement runs at exit), while an ADJACENT `defer[0]` indexes an identifier named `defer`. f(): body writes "v7;", then the deferred forEach writes "a;b;": trace = "v7;a;b;".
rationale: §19.16.1: a `[` separated from `defer` by whitespace is a statement lead; an adjacent `defer[0]` keeps `defer` an ordinary identifier (the word is not at fault).
